notes.title: Patch Notes for E-fcc Demo V.16084005
notes.content:
[h2]Fixes and Improvements:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where a module was getting stuck on the EFCC002 map.
[*] Fixed Trinity's animation issues.
[*] Endgame screen bug resolved.
[*] Camera at the start of the game is now correctly placed in a corner.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes for E-fcc Demo V.16067739
notes.content:
[h2]New Features and Updates:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added 3 new layouts for varied gameplay experiences.
[*] Introduced a blue jersey for the blue team.
[*] The intro video now only plays once.
[*] Fixed an issue where players could get stuck at the end of a match—now the game returns smoothly.
[*] Extended the headshot effect duration by a few seconds.
[/list]
